curriculum.title: Rumor has it that... = It is rumored that... = It is said that...（本句構中 Rumor 恆為不可數）
Rumors spread that...（本句構中 Rumors 應採複數）
sweat a lot = sweat heavily = sweat like a pig
in haste = in a hurry = in a rush
revenue 亦可作 revenues，均不可數
deposit 作及物動詞表「存放」時與 in 或 into 並用；withdraw 表「提領」時與 from 並用
deposit money in / into a bank (account)
express one's sincere thanks / apologies to sb
give sb a 20% / 40% discount on sth
be a chip off the old block
cock 在俚語中是髒話，表「男性生殖器」，故宜用 rooster 表「公雞」（原書用法說明）
